text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Gamble Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Donlands Avenue. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Gamble Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation traffic calming (ten speed humps) on Gamble Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Donlands Avenue, generally as shown in Attachments 2 and 3 to the report (March 16, 2026) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services.
